A geo-fence is a virtual perimeter for a real-world geographic area. A geo-fence could be dynamically generated-as in a radius around a point location, or a geo-fence can be a predefined set of boundaries (such as school zones or neighborhood boundaries).
Geocoding is the process of converting textual postal addresses to a geographical longitude and latitude coordinates.

This service can process a several coordinates in same request. Reverse geocoding is the process of back (reverse) coding of a point location (latitude, longitude) to a readable address or place name. This permits the identification of nearby street addresses, places, and/or areal subdivisions such as neighbourhoods, county, state, or country. Combined with geocoding and routing services, reverse geocoding is a critical component of mobile location-based services and Enhanced 911 to convert a coordinate obtained by GPS to a readable street address which is easier to understand by the end user.

routingMode.description: Defines the route calculation mode. Default is `MODE_VIAS`.

x-enumDescriptions.MODE_VIAS: Computes a serie of routes between successive couples of via coordinates. Examples: from C1 to C2 OR from C1 to C2 to ... to Cn.
x-enumDescriptions.MODE_1_TO_N: Computes routes between a start coordinate to a list of destination coordinates. Examples (Cd is departure): from Cd to C1 OR from Cd to C1, from Cd to C2, ..., from Cd to Cn.
x-enumDescriptions.MODE_N_TO_1: Computes routes between a list of start coordinates to a destination coordinate. Examples (Ca is arrival): from C1 to Ca OR from C1 to Ca, from C2 to Ca, ... from Cn to Ca.
x-enumDescriptions.MODE_N_TO_N: Computes n² routes between each couples of a list of n coordinates.
x-enumDescriptions.MODE_MATRIX: Computes a n x p matrix of path weights between each pair of a list of origin and destination coordinates. Path weights are defined in seconds if `FASTEST` mode, meters if `SHORTEST` mode or Wh (Watt-hour) if `ECO_ENERGY` mode.
x-enumDescriptions.MODE_ISOCHRONE: Builds an isochrone polygon around one or two coordinates. With 1 coordinate: Builds an isochrone polygon representing the area that can be reached through the road network starting from this coordinate with a given limit of time or distance or energy. With two coordinates: Build the isochrone polygon representing the area that can be reached through the road network starting from start, ending at stop and with a given limit of time or distance or energy.

x-enumDescriptions.ROUTESHEET_VERBOSE_HIGH: High level of verbosity for the route sheet.
x-enumDescriptions.FENCE_SHAPE: Enables the tests between route found and geometric fences. Return the shape of fence used to perform the test.
x-enumDescriptions.POLYLINE: Returns the polyline geometry of the entire itinerary. For segmentation of this geometry, see the `EVENT` and `EVT_POLYINE` options.
x-enumDescriptions.DETAILED_POLYLINE: Returns the polyline geometry of the itinerary with more information for each sub-segments. Deprecated, use events system (like `EVENT`, `EVT_POLYLINE`) instead.
x-enumDescriptions.POLYLINE_INDEX: Enables the index calculation of the used destination on the polyline. Deprecated, use events system (like `EVENT`, `EVT_POLYLINE`) instead.
x-enumDescriptions.OPENLR: Attempt to return the geometry of the route as an encoded OpenLR base64 string. Some routes cannot be encoded in OpenLR (like U-turns).
x-enumDescriptions.SEGMENTIDS: Returns the list of segment id of itinerary.
x-enumDescriptions.ROAD_SEGMENTS: Returns the list of road segments of the itinerary. See in response the field `roadSegments`.
x-enumDescriptions.JUNCTION_NODES: Returns the junction nodes of the itinerary. See in response the field `junctionNodes`.
x-enumDescriptions.WAYPOINTS: Returns the waypoints of itinerary. A waypoint is a coordinate with properties that can be used to reproduce the computed route on other device or server.
x-enumDescriptions.MINIMAL_WAYPOINTS: Sub option of `WAYPOINTS` option. Enables the minimal waypoints algorithm. By default the waypoint list contains all waypoints. This option reduces the list to the necessary waypoints to reproduce the route.
x-enumDescriptions.WAYPOINTS_POLYLINE: Returns the polyline of the route including the waypoints coordinate.
x-enumDescriptions.TRAFFIC: Use the traffic info for routing.
x-enumDescriptions.TRAFFIC_PREDICTIVE: Use the predictive traffic info for routing.
x-enumDescriptions.TRAFFIC_PATTERNS: Need the additional `DepartureTime` or `arrivalTime` parameter to work. Use the traffic patterns for routing. This option does not have any effect if the loaded SVS map data does not contain either the HERE Traffic Patterns or TomTom Speed Profiles databases.
x-enumDescriptions.OPTIMIZED_TRIP: Computes an optimized travel through location points. Keep the start and stop points. An optional departure date time (local time) to be used for time dependent restrictions and speeds.
x-enumDescriptions.OPTIMIZED_TRIP_ROUND: See `OPTIMIZED_TRIP` option. Keep the start and come back to the initial point, but don't close the route. To close the route add `OPTIMIZED_TRIP_CLOSED` option.
x-enumDescriptions.OPTIMIZED_TRIP_UNDEFSTOP: See `OPTIMIZED_TRIP` option. Trip from a start point to an undefined final point.
x-enumDescriptions.OPTIMIZED_TRIP_CLOSE: See `OPTIMIZED_TRIP` options. Close the route by performing a routing calculation between the end point and the start point of ordered input coordinates.
x-enumDescriptions.ENERGY_CONSUMPTION: Returns the energy consumption estimation (`energyConsumption` field). This option requires the Energy vehicle feature, see field `routingVehicleProfile` and sub field `routingEnergyVehicleFeature`.
x-enumDescriptions.TOLL_COST: Enables the toll cost calculation. This option requires the Vehicle Profile, see field `routingVehicleProfile` and sub field `routingVehicleFeature`. Contact the support for the required map data. Deprecated replaced by EVT_TOLL_COST option.
x-enumDescriptions.TAX_COST: Enables the tax cost calculation. This option requires the Vehicle Profile, see field `routingVehicleProfile` and sub field `routingVehicleFeature`. Contact the support for the required map data. Deprecated replaced by `EVT_TAX_COST` option.
x-enumDescriptions.ECO_TAX: Enables the eco-tax calculation. The Vehicle feature (vf) and Euro emission class are mandatory. You can use the additional DepartureTime parameter. Deprecated replaced by `EVT_TAX_COST` option.
x-enumDescriptions.SORTBY_USED_ORDER: Sort the UsedDestinations section by the value of `useOrder` field.
x-enumDescriptions.REVGEO_STRICT_DISABLE: Disables the exception event when a coordinate entry is not found.
x-enumDescriptions.REVGEO_POSTAL_ADDRESS: Returns the postal addresses of matched input coordinates.
x-enumDescriptions.ISOCHRONE_FORWARD: Isochrone is built in the direction of traffic flow.
x-enumDescriptions.ISOCHRONE_BACKWARD: Isochrone is built in reverse direction of traffic flow. (by default).
x-enumDescriptions.OPTIMIZED_ROUTE_FOR_CHARGING_STATION: Optimizes electric vehicles charges. Checks if the route is feasible with the. current vehicle profile and the given smart routing profile. If not, the method will try to find optimal (according to the criteria used to compute the route) charging stops. Deprecated used the EV Smart Routing API instead.
x-enumDescriptions.MATRIX_COMPLEMENT: Matrix complement's path weights are defined in meters if fastest mode, seconds otherwise. Also, for performance question, these weights are calculated only for couples of points which are close to each other. For other couples of points, the default value of complement is 0x0FFFFFFF.
x-enumDescriptions.MATRIX_FOR_ROUND_OPTIM: When using the MODE_MATRIX routing mode, this option allows faster matrix computations (by ignoring some coefficients of the matrix) if the returned matrix is intended to be consumed by an external Round Trip Optimization service. Indicates if this method is used to make a round optimization (and therefore number of destination = 0). I this case, some coefficients of the matrix will not be calculated as it is assumed they are not relevant for the route optimization. This allows a faster matrix computation.
x-enumDescriptions.EVENT: Enables structure of events on road. See sub options `EVT_xxxxx` other values. At a minimum the information returned is the country code of every road segment. Each event indicates the distance, travel time and percentage from start.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_DUPLICATE_FILTER: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables filter on repeated values. Avoids repeating events on every road segments when there are no changes.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_ENTRY_VALUE_AS_OBJECT: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables generation of entrie's values as a JSON object instead of encapsulating in a string format.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_ROAD_FEATURE: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the road features such as: maximum speed, bridge, tunnel, number of lanes in each direction, etc.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_PROHIBITED_DRIVING: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the prohibited driving information like against traffic direction (`againstTrafficDir`), prohibited turn (`prohibitedTurn`) and prohibited blocked passage (`prohibitedBlockedPassage`).
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_ELEVATION: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the elevation of road segments. Returns the altitude of first point and last point in two entries. Deprecated, use `EVT_ELEVATION2` instead.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_ELEVATION2: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the elevation of road segments. Returns the altitude of first point and last point in one entry.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_OBJECTID_BASE64: Add object ID information encoded in base64. An BeNomad Object ID is linked to a map data release.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_SEGMENT_INFO: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the road segments information. Returns the ID of road segment (if available in the map data) and the reverse direction flag that indicates if the road segment is traveled in the opposite direction of the geometry of the road in map data.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_GEOELEMENT_TYPE: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the road segment type: The administrative levels (`roadAdminLevel` parameter): `FOURTH_ROAD`, `TERTIARY_ROAD`, `SECONDARY_ROAD`, `MAIN_ROAD`. And the `geoElementType` parameter: `PEDESTRIAN`, `ROUNDABOUT`, `SLIP_ROAD`, `ROAD`, `MOTORWAY`, `FERRY`
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_POLYLINE: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the polyline geometry.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_ENCODED_POLYLINE: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the [encoded polyline geometry](index.html#page-glossary-google_encoded_polyline_algorithm_format.md).
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_LENGTH: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables length in meters of road segment.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_DURATION: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables estimated travel duration in seconds of road segment.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_ENERGY_CONSUMPTION: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the autonomy limit event estimation. Additionally this option requires the Energy vehicle feature (`routingEnergyVehicleFeature`) parameter. The returned `energyEndOfAutonomyAt` field indicates the distance in meters from start. The returned `energyEndOfAutonomyCoord` field indicates the location of the autonomy limit.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_ENERGY_CONSUMPTION_SAMPLE: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the energy consumption estimation with samples data in events structure. Additionally this option requires the Energy vehicle feature (`routingEnergyVehicleFeature`) parameter. The returned energy sample (`EnergySample`) contains the following fields for each second: `distFromStart` in meters, `speed` in m/s, `acceleration` in m/s², `angle` in degrees, `slope` (coefficient), `cumulativeConsumption` in Wh, `pos` coordinate ([WGS84](index.html#page-glossary-coordinate_system.md)) and altitude in meters of event.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_CHARGING_STATION: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Add electrical charging station information (static data). Deprecated Use the API Charging Station.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_CHARGING_STATION_DYNAMIC: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Add electrical charging station information (dynamic data). Deprecated Use the API Charging Station.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_TOLL_COST: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the toll cost calculation. This option requires the Vehicle Profile, see field `routingVehicleProfile` and sub field `routingVehicleFeature`. Contact the support for the required map data. See the response structure `RoutingTollCst` and `Tol` of entry type `TollCost`. Contact the support for the required map data.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_TAX_COST: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the tax cost calculation. This option requires the Vehicle Profile, see field `routingVehicleProfile` and sub field `routingVehicleFeature`. Contact the support for the required map data. See the response structure `RoutingTaxCst` and `RoutingTaxSect` of entry type `TaxCost`. Contact the support for the required map data.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_TRAFFIC: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Returns the real time traffic info in event structure of type `TrafficElement`. The information contains the `jamFactor` in percentage, `reason` (text), `currentAvrSpeed` in km/h, `freeFlowAvrSpeed` in km/h, etc. NOTE: This option does not affect the route calculation, use the option `TRAFFIC` for that. Contact the support for the required map data.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_TRAFFIC_PREDICTIVE: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Returns the real time predictive traffic info in event structure of type `TrafficElement`. The information contains the `jamFactor` in percentage, `reason` (text), `currentAvrSpeed` in km/h, `freeFlowAvrSpeed` in km/h, etc. NOTE: This option does not affect the route calculation. The route calculation is never affect by predictive traffic. Contact the support for the required map data.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_TRAFFIC_HISTORICAL: (Beta) Sub option of `EVENT` option. Returns the historical traffic info (i.e. the real time in the past) in event structure of type `TrafficElement`. Requires a `departureTime` in the past. The information contains the `jamFactor` in percentage, `reason` (text), `currentAvrSpeed` in km/h, `freeFlowAvrSpeed` in km/h, etc. NOTE: This option does not affect the route calculation. The route calculation is never affect by predictive traffic. Contact the support for the required map data.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_ROUTESHEET: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the route-sheet turn-by-turn instructions in event structure with type `Routesheet`. See the class `RoutingInstruc`.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_TRAFFIC_SIGNS: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the traffic sign information in event structure with type `TrafficSign`. `text` (optional) text displayed below traffic sign, `matchedCoordinate` location of traffic sign, `category`, see available values: `NOT_SUPPORTED`, `ROAD_NARROWS`, `SHARP_CURVE_LEFT`, `SHARP_CURVE_RIGHT`, `WINDING_RD_LEFT`, `WINDING_RD_RIGHT`, `STEEP_HILL_UP`, `STEEP_HILL_DOWN`, `LATERAL_WIND`, `GENERAL_WARNING`, `RISK_OF_GROUNDING`, `GENERAL_CURVE`, `GENERAL_HILL`, `OBJECT_OVERHANG`, `ST_NO_OVERTAKING`, `END_NO_OVERTAKING`, `PR_OVERTAKING_EL`, `PR_OVERTAKING_ELR`, `PR_OVERTAKING_ELL`, `LANE_MERGE_RIGHT`, `LANE_MERGE_LEFT`, `LANE_MERGE_CENTER`, `RAILWAY_CROSS_PR`, `RAILWAY_CROSS_UNPR`, `ST_NO_OVERTAKING_TRUCKS`, `END_NO_OVERTAKING_TRUCKS`, `STOP`, `END_OF_ALL_RESTRICTIONS`, `ANIMAL_CROSSING`, `ICY_CONDITIONS`, `SLIPPERY_ROAD`, `FALLING_ROCKS`, `SCHOOL_ZONE`, `TRAMWAY_CROSSING`, `CONGESTION_HAZARD`, `ACCIDENT_HAZARD`, `PRIORITY_ONCOMING`, `YIELD_ONCOMING`, `RIGHT_PRIORITY`, `PEDESTRIAN_CROSSING`, `YIELD`, `NO_ENGINE_BRAKE`, `ENDOF_NO_ENGINE_BRAKE`, `NO_IDLING`, `TRUCK_ROLLOVER`, `LOW_GEAR`, `ENDOF_LOW_GEAR`, `LIGHT`, `DOUBLE_HAIRPIN`, `TRIPLE_HAIRPIN`, `TWO_WAY_TRAFFIC`, `URBAN_AREA`, `HUMP_BRIDGE`, `UNEVEN_ROAD`, `BICYCLE_CROSSING`, `YIELD_TO_BICYCLES`, `NO_TOWED_CARAVAN`, `NO_TOWED_TRAILER`, `NO_CAMPER`, `NO_TURN_ON_RED`, `TURN_ON_RED`, `EMBANKMENT`, `FLOOD_AREA`, `OBSTACLE`, `ROAD_SPLIT`.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_WAYPOINTS: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Returns the waypoints of route in event structure. A waypoint is a coordinate with properties that can be used to reproduce the computed route on other device or server.

routingVehicleProfile.description: A routing vehicle profile defines physical, legal, toll and energetic characteristics.

xyRadius.description: Maximum search radius around GPS point.

startUTurnThreshold.description: Specifies the start UTurn threshold. This value determines, at start point or any via point for which a use start angle / avoid UTurn property is set, the threshold (in 1/10th seconds / meters / Wh in resp. FASTEST / SHORTEST / ECO mode) above which the property may be ignored (default = 3000). For instance, in SHORTEST mode, if the route from start to stop leaving start point in the desired direction is more than `startUTurnThreshold` meters longer than the route from start to stop leaving start point in the opposite direction, leave the start point in the opposite direction.

departureTime.description: This parameter is an EPOCH timestamp in milliseconds (UTC) or a string with ISO local date time format like '2011-12-03T10:15:30', '2011-12-03T10:15:30+01:00' or '2011-12-03T10:15:30+01:00[Europe/Paris]'. It is used to define the date and time of routing departure.

arrivalTime.description: Use this parameter to define the date and time of routing arrival. Can only work with 1 to 1 routing computation mode, no vias are currently permitted or another computation mode like 1 to n, n to 1, n to n and matrix. This parameter is an EPOCH timestamp in milliseconds (UTC) or a string with ISO local date time format like '2011-12-03T10:15:30', '2011-12-03T10:15:30+01:00' or '2011-12-03T10:15:30+01:00[Europe/Paris]'. It is used to define the date and time of routing arrival.

isoChroneLimit.description: The limit of the isochrone. Either meters, seconds or watt/hour depending on the criteria argument (meters if `SHORTEST`, seconds if `FASTEST` and Wh if `ECO_ENERGY`).

corridorRadius.description: Builds a corridor along the calculated route with the given radius. Corridor radius in meters (notes: the corridor width = 2 * `corridorRadius`).

fenceShapes.description: Defines fence shapes to perform an intersection test between the route and the fences.

outputLanguage.description: Defines the preferred language that will be used by the options `ROUTESHEET`, `EVT_ROUTESHEET`, `REVGEO_POSTAL_ADDRESS`, etc. Values of language code: An ASCII string that defines an (ISO 639-1)[https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liste_des_codes_ISO_639-1] (2-letter) language code.

maxAlternativeRoutes.description: Define the maximum number of alternative routes (in range between 0 to 2).

routingChargeFeature.description: Features of Electrical charge used during the routing calculation.

matrixStartCount.description: Number of destination points (`xy` parameter) to be used as start points (all other points will be used as stop points). `0` to disable: all destination points are used both as start and stop points.

customData.description: Custom data. The parameter customData can be repeated and contains a key and value.

RoutingRoadBlck.description: Class representing a routing road block. A road block defines a speed coefficient on a specific road segment. If coefficient is 0, this will close the segment, if not it will affect speed on that segment but will only have an effect if fastest criterium is set.

objectIdBase64.description: Segment object ID to apply the road block.

uniDirectional.description: If true, this road block will only apply in direction defined by a heading (optional). Applies only if a `heading` parameter has been defined

ponderation.description: The speed coefficient in range [0, 256] of this road block (0 will close the road segment).

ponderationType.description: Defines if speed coefficient applies only for searching the fastest route or for calculating the route's travel time (ETA) or both. `ALL` by default.

x-enumDescriptions.ALL: Speed coefficient applies both for finding the fastest route and calculating its ETA. Default value.
x-enumDescriptions.CAL: Speed coefficient applies only searching for the fastest route (only when fastest criteria is set).
x-enumDescriptions.ETA: Speed coefficient applies only for calculating route's travel time (ETA).

RoutingSpeedPond.description: Class representing a routing speed ponderation. Defines a speed coefficient for the specified road element's classification. Note: This parameter has no effect on Traceroute service.

factor.description: Specifies the speed coefficient. A value under 1 to reduce the speed, e.g: 0.8. A value over 1 to increase the speed, e.g: 1.3. `1` by default.

level.description: Road element's level (0: all 4 levels, 1: main level, 2: secondary level, 3: third level, 4: fourth level).

x-enumDescriptions.ALL: Speed coefficient applies both for finding the fastest route and calculating its ETA. Default value.
x-enumDescriptions.CAL: Speed coefficient applies only searching for the fastest route (only when fastest criteria is set).
x-enumDescriptions.ETA: Speed coefficient applies only for calculating route's travel time (ETA).

RoutingVehicleFtr.description: Class representing a routing vehicle features. A routing vehicle feature defines physical, legal and toll characteristics. The map data contains restrictions which are related to vehicle features such as: height, width, length, weight and hazardous materials. Therefore the vehicle features can affect the route calculation. Routing vehicle features can also affect toll and tax cost calculation.

height.description: Height of vehicle in centimeters. Affects route calculation. Physical restriction.

width.description: Width of vehicle in centimeters. Affects route calculation. Physical restriction.

length.description: Length of vehicle in centimeters. Affects route calculation. Physical restriction.

weight.description: Weight of vehicle in tens of metric tons, i.e.: `35` = 3.5t. Affects route calculation. Legal and physical restrictions.

axleWeight.description: Axle weight in tens of metric tons, i.e.: `12` = 1.2t. Affects route calculation. Legal and physical restrictions.

hazardousMaterials.description: Hazardous materials carried by the vehicle. Affects route calculation. Legal restriction.

x-enumDescriptions.EXPLOSIVE: Trucks with Explosive and Flammable Goods.
x-enumDescriptions.WATER: Trucks with Goods Harmful for Water.
x-enumDescriptions.US_CORROSIVE: USA only : Corrosive materials (e.g., hydrochloric acid, sulfuric acid, mercury, sodium hydroxide).
x-enumDescriptions.US_EXPLOSIVES: USA only : Explosives (e.g., TNT, ammunition, flares, fireworks).
x-enumDescriptions.US_FLAM: USA only : Flammable and combustible liquids (e.g., jet fuel, gasoline, fuel oil, alcohols).
x-enumDescriptions.US_FLAM_SOL: USA only : Flammable solids, spontaneously combustible materials and water reactive substances (e.g., matches, white phosphorus, potassium).
x-enumDescriptions.US_GAS: USA only : Flammable, compressed and poisonous gases (e.g., propane, compressed oxygen, chlorine).
x-enumDescriptions.US_ORGANIC: USA only : Oxidizers and organic peroxides (e.g., ammonium nitrate and benzoyl peroxide).
x-enumDescriptions.US_OTHER: USA only : Miscellaneous hazardous materials (e.g., asbestos, dry ice, lithium batteries).
x-enumDescriptions.US_POISON: USA only : Poisonous (toxic) and infectious substances (e.g., cyanide, most mercury-based compounds, viruses, toxins and regulated medical waste).
x-enumDescriptions.US_RADIO_ACTIVE: USA only : Radioactive materials (e.g., plutonium-239 and uranium-235).

nbTrailer.description: Vehicle's number of trailers (`-1`: not defined, `0`: no trailer). Affects route calculation. Legal restriction.

tollTransportCategory.description: Defines the toll vehicle category. Affects toll calculation. `UNDEFINED` by default.

caravan.description: Defines if the vehicle has a caravan. Affects toll calculation. `UNDEFINED` by default.

hybrid.description: Defines if vehicle has a hybrid engine. Affects toll calculation. `UNDEFINED` by default.

disEquipped.description: Defines if vehicle is equipped for disabled people. Affects toll calculation. `UNDEFINED` by default.

pollMin.description: Defines if vehicle has minimal pollution. Affects toll calculation. `UNDEFINED` by default.

hov.description: Defines if vehicle is a High Occupancy Vehicle (USA only). See [Wikipedia: High-occupancy vehicle lane](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/High-occupancy_vehicle_lane). Affects toll calculation. `UNDEFINED` by default.

cial.description: Defines if vehicle is a commercial vehicle. Affects toll calculation. `UNDEFINED` by default.

nbVehAxles.description: Defines the number of axles of the vehicle (optional). Affects toll calculation.

nbTrailAxles.description: Defines the number of axles of the trailer (optional). Affects toll calculation.

nbTires.description: Defines the number of tires (optional). Affects toll calculation.

nbPassengers.description: Defines the number of passengers (optional). Affects toll calculation.

vehHeight.description: Defines vehicle's height in centimeters (optional, use field `height` to define total height : vehicle + trailer). Affects toll calculation.

trailHeight.description: Defines trailer's height in centimeters (optional, use field `height` to define total height : vehicle + trailer). Affects toll calculation.

vehWeight.description: Defines vehicle's weight in tens of tons (optional, use field `weight` to define total weight : vehicle + trailer). Affects toll calculation.

emissionClass.description: Defines vehicle's emission type (optional). See [Wikipedia: European emission standards](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/European_emission_standards). Affects toll calculation.

x-enumDescriptions.EURO2_PRC: EURO II with PRC (Particle Reduction Composite/System)
x-enumDescriptions.EURO3_PRC: EURO III with PRC (Particle Reduction Composite/System)

adrTunnelCategory.description: ADR tunnel category defines all supported ADR (EU only, European Agreement concerning the International Carriage of Dangerous Goods by Road). Affects route calculation.

onlyPhysical.description: Defines if vehicle's weight (weight, weight per axle and trailers) and hazardous materials (hazardous materials and ADR) should be ignored outside respectively bridges and tunnels. `false` by default. Affects route calculation.

RoutingVehicleProf.description: Class representing a routing vehicle profile. A routing vehicle profile defines physical, legal, toll and energetic characteristics.

transportMode.description: Defines the transportation mode: Car, pedestrian, truck, etc. Default value is `CAR`, except for Traceroute service for which default value is `EMERGENCY`. The map data contains information which are related to transportation mode such as: traffic directions, turn restrictions and road accessibility. Therefore the transportation mode can affect the route calculation.

maxSpeeds.description: Defines a maximum speed in km/h for the vehicle. It is possible to discriminate two different maximum speeds: one to be used for route calculation (`CAL`) and another one for route time estimation (`ETA`). By default (`ALL`) the speed applies to both cases.

routingVehicleFeature.description: Defines the routing vehicle feature. A routing vehicle feature defines physical, legal and toll characteristics.

routingEnergyVehicleFeature.description: Energy vehicle feature for energy consumption estimation.

routingEnergyVehicleConnectorTypeIds.description: Connector (plug) type of electrical vehicle, used for energy consumption estimation. Deprecated Use the API Charging Station.

routingEnergyVehicleRanges.description: Energy vehicle range. Define the pre-calculated electric vehicle autonomy in meters.

chargingStationProviderName.description: Name of charging station provider used to research the chargning station pools. Deprecated Use the API Charging Station.

routingSpeedPonderations.description: Defines a speed coefficient for the specified road element's classification. Note: This parameter has no effect on the Traceroute service.

routingCrossPenaltiesCoefficients.description: Defines a cross-penalties coefficient for the specified road element's classification. Note: This parameter has no effect on the Traceroute service.

x-enumDescriptions.USED_DESTINATIONS_OFF: Disables used destinations list in the response.
x-enumDescriptions.ROUTESHEET_VERBOSE_LOW: Low level of verbosity for the route sheet (default).
x-enumDescriptions.ROUTESHEET_VERBOSE_MEDIUM: Medium level of verbosity for the route sheet.
x-enumDescriptions.ROUTESHEET_VERBOSE_HIGH: High level of verbosity for the route sheet.
x-enumDescriptions.FENCE_SHAPE: Enables the tests between route found and geometric fences. Return the shape of fence used to perform the test.
x-enumDescriptions.POLYLINE: Returns the polyline (geometry) of the entire itinerary. For segmentation of this geometry, see the `EVENT` and `EVT_POLYINE` options.
x-enumDescriptions.DETAILED_POLYLINE: Returns the polyline (geometry) of itinerary with more information for each sub-segments. Deprecated, use events system (like `EVENT`, `EVT_POLYLINE`) instead.
x-enumDescriptions.POLYLINE_INDEX: Enables the index calculation of used destination on the polyline. Deprecated, use events system (like `EVENT`, `EVT_POLYLINE`) instead.
x-enumDescriptions.OPENLR: Attempt to return the geometry of route as an encoded OpenLR base64 string. Some routes cannot be encoded in OpenLR (like U-turns).
x-enumDescriptions.SEGMENTIDS: Returns the list of segments id of itinerary.
x-enumDescriptions.ROAD_SEGMENTS: Returns the list of road segments of itinerary. See in response the field `roadSegments`.
x-enumDescriptions.JUNCTION_NODES: Returns the junction nodes of itinerary. See in response the field `junctionNodes`.
x-enumDescriptions.WAYPOINTS: Returns the waypoints of itinerary. A waypoint is a coordinate with properties that can be used to reproduce the computed route on other device or server.
x-enumDescriptions.NO_MINIMAL_WAYPOINTS: Sub option of `WAYPOINTS` option. Disables the minimal waypoints algorithm. By default the waypoint list contains only the waypoints necessary to reproduce the route. With this option all waypoints are returned (faster computation).
x-enumDescriptions.OFFROADS: Sub option of `WAYPOINTS` option. Returns the off-road polylines in the `waypoints` array of the response. See the field `waypoints.offRoad` in response.
x-enumDescriptions.OFFROADS_RAWDATA: Sub option of `OFFROADS` option. Returns the native value of map attributes of the Off-road section.
x-enumDescriptions.WAYPOINTS_POLYLINE: Returns the polyline of the route including the waypoints coordinate.
x-enumDescriptions.ENERGY_CONSUMPTION: Returns the energy consumption estimation (`energyConsumption` field). This option requires the Energy vehicle feature, see field `routingVehicleProfile` and sub field `routingEnergyVehicleFeature`.
x-enumDescriptions.TOLL_COST: Enables the toll cost calculation. This option requires the Vehicle Profile, see field `routingVehicleProfile` and sub field `routingVehicleFeature`. Contact the support for the required map data. Deprecated replaced by EVT_TOLL_COST option.
x-enumDescriptions.TAX_COST: Enables the tax cost calculation. This option requires the Vehicle Profile, see field `routingVehicleProfile` and sub field `routingVehicleFeature`. Contact the support for the required map data. Deprecated replaced by EVT_TAX_COST option.
x-enumDescriptions.ECO_TAX: Enables the eco-tax calculation. This option requires the Vehicle Profile, see field `routingVehicleProfile` and sub field `routingVehicleFeature`. Contact the support for the required map data. Deprecated replaced by EVT_TAX_COST option.
x-enumDescriptions.REVGEO_POSTAL_ADDRESS: Returns the postal addresses of matched input coordinates.
x-enumDescriptions.EVENT: Enables structure of events on road. See sub options `EVT_xxxxx` other values. At a minimum the information returned is the country code of every road segment. Each event indicates the distance, travel time and percentage from start.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_DUPLICATE_FILTER: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables filter on repeated values. Avoids repeating events on every road segments when there are no changes.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_ENTRY_VALUE_AS_OBJECT: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables generation of entrie's values as a JSON object instead of encapsulating in a string format.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_ROAD_FEATURE: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the road features such as: maximum speed, bridge, tunnel, number of lanes in each direction, etc.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_PROHIBITED_DRIVING: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the prohibited driving information like against traffic direction (`againstTrafficDir`), prohibited turn (`prohibitedTurn`) and prohibited blocked passage (`prohibitedBlockedPassage`).
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_ELEVATION: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the elevation of road segments. Returns the altitude of first point and last point in two entries. Deprecated, use `EVT_ELEVATION2` instead.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_ELEVATION2: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the elevation of road segments. Returns the altitude of first point and last point in one entry.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_SEGMENT_INFO: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the road segments information. Returns the ID of road segment (if available in the map data) and the reverse direction flag that indicates if the road segment is traveled in the opposite direction of the geometry of the road in map data.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_GEOELEMENT_TYPE: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the road segment type: The administrative levels (`roadAdminLevel` parameter): `FOURTH_ROAD`, `TERTIARY_ROAD`, `SECONDARY_ROAD`, `MAIN_ROAD`. And the `geoElementType` parameter: `PEDESTRIAN`, `ROUNDABOUT`, `SLIP_ROAD`, `ROAD`, `MOTORWAY`, `FERRY`
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_POLYLINE: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the polyline geometry.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_ENCODED_POLYLINE: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the [encoded polyline geometry](index.html#page-glossary-google_encoded_polyline_algorithm_format.md).
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_LENGTH: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables length in meters of road segment.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_DURATION: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables estimated travel duration in seconds of road segment.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_ENERGY_CONSUMPTION: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the autonomy limit event estimation. Additionally this option requires the Energy vehicle feature (`routingEnergyVehicleFeature`) parameter. The returned `energyEndOfAutonomyAt` field indicates the distance in meters from start. The returned `energyEndOfAutonomyCoord` field indicates the location of the autonomy limit.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_ENERGY_CONSUMPTION_SAMPLE: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the energy consumption estimation with samples data in events structure. Additionally this option requires the Energy vehicle feature (`routingEnergyVehicleFeature`) parameter. The returned energy sample (`EnergySample`) contains the following fields for each second: `distFromStart` in meters, `speed` in m/s, `acceleration` in m/s², `angle` in degrees, `slope` (coefficient), `cumulativeConsumption` in Wh, `pos` coordinate ([WGS84](index.html#page-glossary-coordinate_system.md)) and altitude in meters of event.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_CHARGING_STATION: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Add electrical charging station information (static data). Deprecated Use the API Charging Station.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_CHARGING_STATION_DYNAMIC: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Add electrical charging station information (dynamic data). Deprecated Use the API Charging Station.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_TOLL_COST: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the toll cost calculation. This option requires the Vehicle Profile, see field `routingVehicleProfile` and sub field `routingVehicleFeature`. Contact the support for the required map data. See the response structure `RoutingTollCst` and `Tol` of entry type `TollCost`. Contact the support for the required map data.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_TAX_COST: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the tax cost calculation. This option requires the Vehicle Profile, see field `routingVehicleProfile` and sub field `routingVehicleFeature`. Contact the support for the required map data. See the response structure `RoutingTaxCst` and `RoutingTaxSect` of entry type `TaxCost`. Contact the support for the required map data.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_TRAFFIC: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Returns the real time traffic info in event structure of type `TrafficElement`. The information contains the `jamFactor` in percentage, `reason` (text), `currentAvrSpeed` in km/h, `freeFlowAvrSpeed` in km/h, etc. NOTE: This option does not affect the route calculation, use the option `TRAFFIC` for that.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_TRAFFIC_PREDICTIVE: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Returns the real time predictive traffic info in event structure of type `TrafficElement`. The information contains the `jamFactor` in percentage, `reason` (text), `currentAvrSpeed` in km/h, `freeFlowAvrSpeed` in km/h, etc. NOTE: This option does not affect the route calculation. The route calculation is never affect by predictive traffic. Contact the support for the required map data.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_TRAFFIC_HISTORICAL: (Beta) Sub option of `EVENT` option. Returns the historical traffic info (i.e. the real time in the past) in event structure of type `TrafficElement`. Requires a `departureTime` in the past. The information contains the `jamFactor` in percentage, `reason` (text), `currentAvrSpeed` in km/h, `freeFlowAvrSpeed` in km/h, etc. NOTE: This option does not affect the route calculation. The route calculation is never affect by predictive traffic. Contact the support for the required map data.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_ROUTESHEET: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the route-sheet turn-by-turn instructions in event structure with type `Routesheet`. See the class `RoutingInstruc`.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_TRAFFIC_SIGNS: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Enables the traffic sign information in event structure with type `TrafficSign`. `text` (optional) text displayed below traffic sign, `matchedCoordinate` location of traffic sign, `category`, see available values: `NOT_SUPPORTED`, `ROAD_NARROWS`, `SHARP_CURVE_LEFT`, `SHARP_CURVE_RIGHT`, `WINDING_RD_LEFT`, `WINDING_RD_RIGHT`, `STEEP_HILL_UP`, `STEEP_HILL_DOWN`, `LATERAL_WIND`, `GENERAL_WARNING`, `RISK_OF_GROUNDING`, `GENERAL_CURVE`, `GENERAL_HILL`, `OBJECT_OVERHANG`, `ST_NO_OVERTAKING`, `END_NO_OVERTAKING`, `PR_OVERTAKING_EL`, `PR_OVERTAKING_ELR`, `PR_OVERTAKING_ELL`, `LANE_MERGE_RIGHT`, `LANE_MERGE_LEFT`, `LANE_MERGE_CENTER`, `RAILWAY_CROSS_PR`, `RAILWAY_CROSS_UNPR`, `ST_NO_OVERTAKING_TRUCKS`, `END_NO_OVERTAKING_TRUCKS`, `STOP`, `END_OF_ALL_RESTRICTIONS`, `ANIMAL_CROSSING`, `ICY_CONDITIONS`, `SLIPPERY_ROAD`, `FALLING_ROCKS`, `SCHOOL_ZONE`, `TRAMWAY_CROSSING`, `CONGESTION_HAZARD`, `ACCIDENT_HAZARD`, `PRIORITY_ONCOMING`, `YIELD_ONCOMING`, `RIGHT_PRIORITY`, `PEDESTRIAN_CROSSING`, `YIELD`, `NO_ENGINE_BRAKE`, `ENDOF_NO_ENGINE_BRAKE`, `NO_IDLING`, `TRUCK_ROLLOVER`, `LOW_GEAR`, `ENDOF_LOW_GEAR`, `LIGHT`, `DOUBLE_HAIRPIN`, `TRIPLE_HAIRPIN`, `TWO_WAY_TRAFFIC`, `URBAN_AREA`, `HUMP_BRIDGE`, `UNEVEN_ROAD`, `BICYCLE_CROSSING`, `YIELD_TO_BICYCLES`, `NO_TOWED_CARAVAN`, `NO_TOWED_TRAILER`, `NO_CAMPER`, `NO_TURN_ON_RED`, `TURN_ON_RED`, `EMBANKMENT`, `FLOOD_AREA`, `OBSTACLE`, `ROAD_SPLIT`.
x-enumDescriptions.EVT_WAYPOINTS: Sub option of `EVENT` option. Returns the waypoints of route in event structure. A waypoint is a coordinate with properties that can be used to reproduce the computed route on other device or server.

routingVehicleProfile.description: A routing vehicle profile defines physical, legal, toll and energetic characteristics.

departureTime.description: This parameter is an EPOCH timestamp in milliseconds (UTC) or a string with ISO local date time format like '2011-12-03T10:15:30', '2011-12-03T10:15:30+01:00' or '2011-12-03T10:15:30+01:00[Europe/Paris]'. It is used to define the date and time of routing departure.

adjustEta.description: Defines if the calculated route's ETA should match with field `time` of input `destinations` (GPS time in milliseconds (EPOCH)). The field `time` of input `destinations` must be filled.

allowOffRoad.description: Defines if the returned route are computed with off-roads. Otherwise, no off-road are created. True by default.

corridorRadius.description: Builds a corridor along the calculated route with the given radius. Corridor radius in meters (notes: the corridor width = 2 * `corridorRadius`).

fenceShapes.description: Defines fence shapes to perform an intersection test between the route and the fences.

language.description: Defines the preferred language that will be used by the options `ROUTESHEET`, `EVT_ROUTESHEET`, `REVGEO_POSTAL_ADDRESS`, etc. Values of language code: An ASCII string that defines an (ISO 639-1)[https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liste_des_codes_ISO_639-1] (2-letter) language code.

stopDuration.description: Stop duration in seconds associated to the destination coordinate. By default `0`. Note: if charging times are defined. Forced charges take priority over charge times. Note: only about forced charge, stop duration could be linked chargeMaxDist in case of forced charge. To ensure that charge duration is superior to stopDuration + FixedStopTime in EV Smart Routing, the stop duration used is min(stopDuration, KB_MIN_CHARGE_DURATION + FixedStopTime). However the original value stopDuration is not modified.

chargeMaxDist.description: This parameter should be defined to impose a charge around this destination. It defines the maximum walking distance 3000 meters a charge point can be from this destination to force a charge (0 means no charge forced). By default `0`. NOTE: If you combine this parameter with the `stopDuration` parameter it will define how much time can be used for charging.

StepPointTimeSlot.description:
Represents a time slot which will be used to charge the vehicle. It is defined by a begin date/time an end date/time and a stop duration in seconds. For EV Smart Routing, StepPointTimeSlot is valid if:
  - A departure date and time has been set.
  - Beginning of the time slot is before end of the time slot.
  - Stop time duration is strictly superior to the step-point's plugging time.
  - Beginning time plus stop time duration is inferior or equal to end time.
  - Time slot's begin should be after the departure time.
  - Time slot's end should be before arrival time once stop is reachable.

 >Note: If forced charges are defined, they take priority over charge times.

startDateTime.description: Start local date time in text format ISO YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss (e.g: 2020-09-08T12:28:00).

stopDateTime.description: Stop local date time in text format ISO YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss (e.g: 2020-09-08T12:28:00).

serviceCategory.description:
Service category that can be associated to a time slot. This parameter describes, in combination with an optional maximum pedestrian walking distance (see parameter `maxWalkingDistance`), a boolean expression with all the services requested or unwanted.
Semantics:
  - `!`: not (unary).
  - `|`: or (binary).
  - `&`: and (binary).

ChargeTimeSlot.description:
Represents a time slot which will be used to charge the vehicle. It is defined by a begin time, which should be after the departure time of the route, a end time, and a stop duration which should be inferior to (stopDateTime - startDateTime) and should be strictly superior to the stop time duration For EV Smart Routing, StepPointTimeSlot is valid if:
  - A departure date and time have been set.
  - Beginning of the time slot is before end of the time slot.
  - Stop time duration is strictly positive and strictly superior to the fixed stop time.
  - Beginning time plus stop time duration is inferior or equal to end time.
  - Time slot's begin should be after the departure time.
  - Time slot's begin should be before arrival time once stop is reachable. For EV Smart Routing, a time slot has a margin of +/- 1 minute.

 >Note: If forced charges are defined, they take priority over charge times.

Code of the time slot status. Available codes:
- `TSS_UNINITIALIZED`: Time slot status uninitialized.
- `TSS_NO_POOL_FOUND`: No pool found during this time slot (default value before EVRoute computation).
- `TSS_NO_POOL_FOUND_WITH_SERVICE`: No pool found with the requested services.
- `TSS_NOT_SELECTED_TOO_MUCH_ENERGY_NEEDED`: Too much additional energy needed to reach pools during this time slot.
- `TSS_NOT_SELECTED_OPENING_TIME`: Opening Time are incorrect for pools found during these time slot.
- `TSS_NOT_SELECTED`: Route with the pools found during this time slot validate less time slot that this current itinerary OR charge during time slot is useless.
- `TSS_IGNORED_DEPARTURE_DATE_TIME_NOT_SET`: Time slot ignored: Departure date and time is not set.
- `TSS_IGNORED_END_BEFORE_DEPARTURE`: Time slot ignored: Time slot end is before route departure OR stop duration implied to stop before route departure.
- `TSS_IGNORED_BEGIN_AFTER_ARRIVAL`: Time slot ignored: Time slot begins after arrival date and time.
- `TSS_IGNORED_INTERNAL_ERROR`: Time slot ignored: Internal error.
- `TSS_NOT_VALID_BEGIN_AFTER_END`: Time slot not valid: Time slot begins after time slot end.
- `TSS_NOT_VALID_DURATION_TOO_SHORT`: Time slot not valid: Stop duration is too short (should be superior to fixed stop time).
- `TSS_NOT_VALID_DURATION_TOO_LONG`: Time slot not valid: Stop duration is too long (should be inferior to time slot duration).
- `TSS_NOT_VALID_SERVICE`: Time slot not valid: Requested service format is incorrect").
